issues: 灰阶画布上便签只有 18–21px 小字，整张画面像占位稿
五枚光标和名牌偏小（13.5px 名牌），"团队在场"只能靠颜色认
Rita 打字时箭头和插入点各算各的，箭头停在句尾附近而不是跟着字走
画面没有空间层次与界面上下文（没有板名、在线头像、工具条），读不出是白板产品
changes: look 改 porcelain，做成为镜头设计的白板：左上板名、右上在线头像组、底部浮动工具条、点阵画布、6 张 36px 可读便签 + 中央大简报卡
身份编码三处一致：五人五色光标 / 便签作者色淡彩底与圆点 / 头像组随每人入场同帧弹出（槽宽随弹出长，不留空位）
Rita 的箭头挂在行内插入点锚点上，88px 标题 "Ship the beta to 2,000 teams." 带人手节奏逐字出现，换行也跟着走；打完卡片 Draft → Ready、进度 38% → 72%
四层空间：画布 / 便签（远层虚化降对比）/ 简报卡 / 光标，全程 1→1.045 极缓推镜，远层视差更小
聚拢位重排到卡片四周，任何名牌都不压标题与眉题；漂移保留 25%，hold 段画面仍活着
issuesEn: Grayscale canvas with 18–21px sticky text; the whole frame reads like a placeholder
Cursors and 13.5px tags are small; 'the team is here' only reads through color
Rita's arrow and the text caret are positioned independently, so the arrow parks near the line end instead of riding the caret
No depth and no product context (no board name, presence avatars or toolbar) — it doesn't read as a whiteboard app
changesEn: Porcelain look with a board designed for camera: board name, live avatar stack, floating toolbar, dot-grid canvas, six readable 36px stickies and a large central brief card
Identity coded three ways: five cursor colors, sticky tints and author dots, and presence avatars that pop in the same frame each person arrives (slots grow, no gaps)

Rita's arrow is attached to an inline caret anchor; the 88px title 'Ship the beta to 2,000 teams.' types with human jitter and the arrow follows across the line wrap; the card then flips Draft → Ready and 38% → 72%
Four depth layers (canvas, blurred far stickies, brief card, cursors) with a slow 1→1.045 push and reduced parallax on the far layer
Gather positions re-laid around the card so no tag covers the title or eyebrow; 25% drift kept so the hold stays alive
